naming_convention.FE: false-early emission on teacher-positive episode (emit_step < corridor_start)
naming_convention.LI: late-or-invalid emission on teacher-positive episode (emit_step > corridor_end)
naming_convention.FPn: false positive on no-corridor negative episode (no corridor, emitted)
naming_convention.TN: true negative / correct abstention (no corridor, no emission)

coverage.description: Fraction of teacher-positive episodes with correct-window emission

false_early_rate.description: Fraction of teacher-positive episodes where emit occurs before corridor_start

late_or_invalid_rate.description: Fraction where emit occurs after corridor_end

missed_positive_rate.description: Fraction of teacher-positive episodes with no emission

k10_containment.description: Emit step t such that [t, t+K-1] fully within [corridor_start, corridor_end]. Redundant with CW under current corridor_active_at_t definition.

no_corridor_fpr.description: False positive rate on teacher-negative episodes

correct_abstention.description: Fraction of teacher-negative episodes correctly abstained

signed_error.description: Positive = emit AFTER anchor. Computed only on teacher-positive emitted episodes.

overall_emission_rate.description: Fraction of all held-out episodes with any emission

aggregation.cross_fold: task-macro mean, episode-micro mean, task-level std, worst-task, best-task
